sonnet.problem: Card 4 already shows the right answer "Who is the LORD that I should obey Him", which implies Pharaoh doesn't know the LORD. Card 5 then asks whether Pharaoh says he knows the LORD. That re-asks the same point, and the answer to this False statement is already given away.
sonnet.rule: An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: Card 15 already asked that because of His mighty hand Pharaoh will let the people go. Card 16 asks about the parallel line in the same verse (6:1), that because of His strong hand Pharaoh will drive them out. Both make the same point, so they should be one question. Card 15 also hands over most of card 16's answer.
